changes.comment: The hosting application can now fully control outgoing map-layer requests: MapLayerFormatRegistry.addMapLayerFetchHandler registers a handler in a pipeline wrapping every map-layer send like a .NET DelegatingHandler - it may decline a request it does not manage (returning undefined, leaving it to the next handler or the default behavior), send a copy of the request with other headers and query parameters (e.g. inject an Authorization header for services behind an authenticating proxy), retry transparently after refreshing a token, short-circuit, or throw the now-public MapLayerAuthenticationFailedError to transition layers to RequireAuth. Applies to tiles, tooltips, capabilities, service metadata and source validation across all map-layer formats; every send a handler requests is credentialed (trusted-origins redirect policy, no SSO retry), and no downstream handler can downgrade that; URL-keyed metadata caches are bypassed while a handler is registered. Also fixed: WMS/WMTS GetCapabilities requests issued when a layer initializes now include the layer's custom query parameters, matching source validation.
